notes.title: 🐾 NABI Season 2 Update Announcement 🐾
notes.content:
🐾 NABI Season 2 Update Announcement 🐾

NABI Season 2 is finally here!
Get ready for new challenges and exciting updates.

Update Details

1️⃣ 10 new doors have been opened.
2️⃣ Mouse Invert Mode has been added to the options menu.
3️⃣ Stickers for Season 1 Nabiteers have been added.
4️⃣ Devices have been installed in some rooms to prevent falling outside.

🎉 Season 2 Event Announcement 🎉
The Sticker Event is back this season!
Here’s how you can join and make your mark in Season 2.

1. Sticker Upgrades

Players who cleared Season 1 and successfully clear Season 2 will receive:
Sticker size doubled.
The option to relocate their sticker.

2. Audio File Feature

Both returning players from Season 1 and new players who clear Season 2 can:
Add an audio file that plays at their sticker’s location.
Submit a 10-15 second MP3 or WAV file, which will be linked to their sticker.

3. Stickers for New Clear Players

New players who successfully reach the top in Season 2 can also participate in the sticker event.
How to Participate
Add Fancysquare as a friend.
Follow the detailed instructions to register your sticker and audio file.

Best of luck, and we’re looking forward to your incredible achievements!
Make your mark in Season 2 of NABI. 😊

notes.title: NABI Game Update Announcement
notes.content:
NABI Game Update Announcement

We’re excited to announce an upcoming update for NABI, scheduled for January 6th, after the New Year holiday period. This update will bring some changes to the game, including an increase in the height required to complete the game’s 5th challenge. The journey to clear the game will become even more challenging!

Here’s what you need to know:

Until January 6th, you can continue to challenge the 5th task (Game Clear) at its current height.
Once the update goes live on January 6th, the height required to complete the 5th task will be raised, making your jump journey longer and more difficult.
Season 1 will conclude on January 5th, so make sure to complete any challenges before then!
NABI's Season 2 Gateway Opened by 14 Players

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45173674/cbfb074a0dadca6fb8645d72c719aa4194f0ef0b.png

A big thank you and congratulations to the 14 players who have cleared the game!
Because of your incredible achievement, Season 2 of NABI is now possible. Your determination and skill have paved the way for others to experience the next chapter of this game. We wouldn’t have reached this point without you!

Here are the names of the players who opened the gateway to Season 2 of NABI:



We’re excited to see how you all progress, and we can’t wait for the new challenges ahead! Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: NABI Announcement: Special Event and Season Update
NABI Announcement: Special Event and Season Update
notes.content:
🎉 NABI BIG NEWS 1: Special Event

We’ve prepared an exciting event for players who clear NABI!

Players who successfully clear the game will have the opportunity to customize the doors that NABI jumps through with their own unique designs or doodles.

Options available: Choose from a poster, photo, or sticker.
Placement: You can select the door’s location in the game.
Restrictions: Inappropriate text or images that violate community standards will not be allowed. The size of the customization will match the example below (e.g., the "SUMMER" text size).
⚠️ Important Notes

Once finalized, the design cannot be changed, but you may request its removal.
Designs cannot overlap other players’ designs but can be placed right next to them.
How to participate:

Add Fancysquare as a friend after clearing the game to receive detailed instructions for submitting your image file.
Once the file is submitted, it will be updated within two days.
This event will continue indefinitely unless special circumstances arise.

📅 Players eligible for this event as of December 21, 2024: 

_LimeSoda_  요비Yobi  파파상어 Honnanda

Please add the Fancysquare account as a friend if your name is listed below.





🎮 NABI BIG NEWS 2: Season-Based Operation and Free Updates

NABI operates on a seasonal system, and all additional updates will be free of charge.
Currently, we are in Season 1, and a new season will start when 10 players clear the game.

📈 Updates for Each Season

Increased height for NABI to climb:
Each season adds 10 to 15 meters, equivalent to 1,500 to 2,000 points.
Yes, that means more terrifying doors to overcome!
High scores will not reset:
Your existing scores will remain, but the difficulty of the fifth and final challenge will steadily increase.
From the start of development, NABI has been designed to operate with this seasonal structure.
NABI’s jumps will continue endlessly. The Abyss is that kind of place.

To all the brave players who cleared NABI, we await your participation. Good luck! 🐾

notes.title: NABI’s First Update is Here!
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thank you so much for your support and feedback since NABI’s release. Today, we’re thrilled to share the details of NABI’s very first update!

Update Notes  ______________________________________________

Bug Fixes
We’ve addressed several reported issues to improve the overall gameplay experience. Thank you for bringing them to our attention!
Multilingual Support for the Scoreboard

The scoreboard is now available in multiple languages, making it easier for players from all over the world to compete and share their progress.


No Difficulty Adjustments
This update focuses on technical improvements, and no changes have been made to the game’s difficulty.

NABI is designed to be a unique and challenging experience that tests your patience, precision, and perseverance. The joy of overcoming such challenges is at the heart of the game. Each door you pass through and each successful jump is a testament to your determination.

We hope NABI continues to stand as one of the toughest games out there, inspiring players to aim for greater heights and push their limits.


Special Congratulations
A huge congratulations to Yobi and LimeSoda for completing NABI! Your skill and persistence in conquering this challenging journey deserve a round of applause.

Thank you again for your passion and support. Your encouragement drives us to keep improving.
See you at the top!

- The NABI Team

notes.title: NABI, The Beginning of Inspiration
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173674/00d10e990fe4caf45fb85e1f9c465ac74314b0a0.png

Why did the army pig say he wouldn’t go there?

Because the evil spirits were terribly afraid of it.

Why were they afraid of that place?

In TV shows, novels, movies, and games, the Abyss is often depicted as the deep sea, the depths underground, or hell.

We wanted to portray the Abyss as it is described in the Bible, literally.

Abyss is literally called a bottomless pit.

NABI, the Beginning of Inspiration



-  The Abyss is described as a bottomless place.

-  It is such a terrifying space that even demons and evil spirits don’t want to go there.

-  It's a different space from the sheol, and it's deeper than the sheol.

-  In the end times, Lucifer is said to be locked up there.



This place is on a different dimension from what we normally imagine.

When we consider terms like "bottom" or "down below," we imagine it as a place of endless falling.

It is a space where you could fall without end.

That place is filled with darkness, a silent and desolate space with no sound, and endless suffering.

That is the Abyss.



Next time, I will tell you about the endless doors that exist in the Abyss.

Thank you for your interest.
